The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Email Event ASIM parser for Proofpoint TAP blocked messages
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled:bool = false, pack:bool = false) {
    let Address = (value:dynamic) {
        let text = iff(gettype(value) == "array",
            iff(array_length(value) == 1, tostring(value[0]), ""), tostring(value));
        trim(" ", iff(indexof(text, "<") >= 0, tostring(split(tostring(split(text, "<")[1]), ">")[0]), text))
    };
    let Addresses = (value:dynamic) {
        parse_json(replace_strings(tostring(coalesce(value, dynamic([]))),
            dynamic(["<", ">"]), dynamic(["", ""])))
    };
    ProofPointTAPMessagesBlockedV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | extend
        EmailFromAddress = coalesce(Address(fromAddress), Address(headerFrom)),
        EmailReplyToAddress = coalesce(Address(replyToAddress), Address(headerReplyTo)),
        EmailMailFromAddress = Address(sender),
        EmailToRecipients = Addresses(toAddresses),
        EmailCCRecipients = Addresses(ccAddresses),
        EnvelopeRecipients = Addresses(recipient),
        // Only a single threat can populate scalar fields without losing multi-threat context.
        Threat = case(gettype(threatsInfoMap) == "dictionary", threatsInfoMap,
            array_length(threatsInfoMap) == 1, threatsInfoMap[0], dynamic(null)),
        Part = case(gettype(messageParts) == "dictionary", messageParts,
            array_length(messageParts) == 1, messageParts[0], dynamic(null))
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(messageTime, TimeGenerated),
        EventEndTime = coalesce(messageTime, TimeGenerated),
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventType = "EmailDelivery",
        EventOriginalType = "messagesBlocked",
        EventResult = "Failure",
        EventSchema = "EmailEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventVendor = "Proofpoint",
        EventProduct = "TAP Messages",
        EventOriginalUid = coalesce(GUID, tostring(column_ifexists("id", ""))),
        Dvc = coalesce(cluster, "Proofpoint TAP"),
        DvcAction = "Quarantined",
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        EmailFromDomain = tostring(split(EmailFromAddress, "@")[1]),
        EmailMailFromDomain = tostring(split(EmailMailFromAddress, "@")[1]),
        EmailReplyToDomain = tostring(split(EmailReplyToAddress, "@")[1]),
        EmailDirection = "Unknown",
        EmailDeliveryLocation = "Quarantine",
        EmailProtocolName = "SMTP",
        EmailSizeBytes = tolong(messageSize),
        Dst = iff(array_length(EnvelopeRecipients) == 1, tostring(EnvelopeRecipients[0]),
            iff(array_length(EnvelopeRecipients) > 1, tostring(EnvelopeRecipients), "")),
        ThreatOriginalCategory = tostring(Threat.classification),
        ThreatId = tostring(Threat.threatID),
        ThreatName = tostring(Threat.threat),
        ThreatFirstReportedTime = todatetime(Threat.threatTime),
        ThreatIsActive = case(tolower(tostring(Threat.threatStatus)) == "active", true,
            tolower(tostring(Threat.threatStatus)) in ("cleared", "falsepositive"), false, bool(null)),
        EventReportUrl = tostring(Threat.threatUrl),
        // Message parts can contain bodies as well as attachments; do not count them as files.
        EmailFiles = iff(tolower(tostring(Part.disposition)) == "attached", pack_array(Part), dynamic([])),
        RuleName = quarantineRule,
        AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
            "GUID", GUID, "messageID", messageID, "QID", QID,
            "cluster", cluster, "completelyRewritten", completelyRewritten,
            "fromAddress", fromAddress, "headerFrom", headerFrom, "headerReplyTo", headerReplyTo,
            "replyToAddress", replyToAddress, "sender", sender,
            "recipient", recipient, "toAddresses", toAddresses, "ccAddresses", ccAddresses,
            "impostorScore", impostorScore, "malwareScore", malwareScore,
            "phishScore", phishScore, "spamScore", spamScore,
            "messageParts", messageParts, "threatsInfoMap", threatsInfoMap,
            "messageTime", messageTime, "messageSize", messageSize,
            "modulesRun", modulesRun, "policyRoutes", policyRoutes,
            "quarantineFolder", quarantineFolder, "quarantineRule", quarantineRule,
            "xmailer", xmailer, "TenantId", column_ifexists("TenantId", ""),
            "_ResourceId", column_ifexists("_ResourceId", "")), dynamic({}))
    | extend
        EventUid = EventOriginalUid,
        SrcUserName = EmailMailFromAddress,
        Src = senderIP,
        ThreatCategory = case(tolower(ThreatOriginalCategory) == "phish", "Phishing",
            tolower(ThreatOriginalCategory) == "malware", "Malware",
            tolower(ThreatOriginalCategory) == "spam", "Spam",
            tolower(ThreatOriginalCategory) == "impostor", "Impersonation",
            tolower(ThreatOriginalCategory) == "toad", "TOAD", ""),
        EventResultDetails = case(tolower(ThreatOriginalCategory) == "phish", "PhishingDetected",
            tolower(ThreatOriginalCategory) == "malware", "MalwareDetected", "Other")
    | project-rename EmailSubject = subject, SrcIpAddr = senderIP, EmailOriginalDeliveryLocation = quarantineFolder
    | extend IpAddr = SrcIpAddr, User = SrcUserName, Rule = RuleName
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount, EventType, EventOriginalType,
        EventResult, EventResultDetails, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct,
        EventOriginalUid, EventUid, EventReportUrl, Dvc, DvcAction, DvcEntityKey, AdditionalEntities,
        EmailFromAddress, EmailFromDomain, EmailMailFromAddress, EmailMailFromDomain,
        EmailReplyToAddress, EmailReplyToDomain, EmailToRecipients, EmailCCRecipients,
        EmailSubject, EmailSizeBytes, EmailDirection, EmailDeliveryLocation, EmailOriginalDeliveryLocation,
        EmailProtocolName, EmailFiles,
        Dst, Src, SrcIpAddr, IpAddr, SrcUserName, User, RuleName, Rule,
        ThreatId, ThreatName, ThreatCategory, ThreatOriginalCategory, ThreatFirstReportedTime,
        ThreatIsActive, AdditionalFields
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
